title: Securing Reliability: A Brief Overview on Enhancing In-Context Learning for Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using template-based synthetic sources, real web texts, and counterfactual datasets to investigate gendered unfairness and probe toxicity in foundation models.
Utilizing meticulously designed counterfactual datasets to probe toxicity across different religious identities.
Employing counterfactual datasets and soft-prompt tuning techniques to reveal and evaluate toxicity and bias patterns regarding sexuality.
Evaluating geopolitical and cultural stereotypes using broad-coverage benchmark datasets spanning 178 countries leveraged by generative models.
Employing soft-prompt tuning to reveal and evaluate bias patterns across age groups.
